english.title: Manufacturer register / place vehicle on market with un permitted defeat system
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 14(1) and paragraph 3(1)(a) of Schedule 4 to the Road Vehicles (Approval) Regulations 2020.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a manufacturer of motor vehicles
placed a vehicle on the market / registered a vehicle in the United Kingdom
fitted with a defeat system
which was not permitted

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: A separate offence is committed in respect of each motor vehicle placed on the market or registered, with a defeat system that was not permitted.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE STATEMENT OF FACTS..).

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine.

TIme limit for prosecutions:
6 months Note
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited
